content_zh:
苏景道：“我去找燕南天，不是要去找他救命的，而是要去告诉燕南天，江枫被移花宫的妖女挟持，妖女看中了他的美色，将其逆推**，更使他不得自由……”
说到这里，邀月皱了皱眉，脸上露出了不快的神色！
当着和尚骂秃子……这是连自己也给骂了进去了！
若轮回世界有成就系统，恐怕苏景此时已经取得了臭骂邀月第一人的成就了！
但看着苏景那愤怒的神色，邀月也只能当他是愤怒之下，口不择言了吧。
而此时，面对邀月这等魔头，苏景也不敢有丝毫懈怠，小小的讥讽了一下，脑筋转的飞快，甚至于还没组织好后续的计划，口中已经飞快的说了出来，这种时候，考验的就是急智，决不能有半点的破绽，如果让她看出自己在思考的话，就真的完蛋了！
他解释道：“邀月宫主可能有所不知，天下第一剑燕南天武功虽高，但性格却极为粗犷鲁莽，我在江枫手下做书童，与其多有来往，他对我极其信任，待得将燕南天带到江枫身侧，我若告之燕南天，那花月奴便是挟持江枫之人……”
邀月娇躯一震，看向苏景的眼神隐隐有光芒闪动，道：“那燕南天投鼠忌器，必定不会出面挑战，你若在旁鼓吹两句，让他背后偷袭并非难事！”
苏景冷笑道：“我便是要看看，当江枫的至亲之人杀死了他的至爱之人，而动手的理由还是为了救他的时候……他的表情，到底是怎么样的……有趣……”
“岂止是你想看……便连我，也忍不住想看了……”
邀月脸上表情狰狞的吓人……只是眼底的快意，却怎么也遮掩不去，看着楚南的眼神，也带着浓浓的钦佩……
她说道：“这么说来，真是幸亏了我没有直接把你杀死，不然，岂非看不到这么一出好戏了？”
“我死不死倒是无妨……左右那花月奴已经为江枫生下了一双儿女，我不可能再要这个破鞋，此生已无生趣可言……只要能看到江枫和她痛苦的面容，只要能偿了我心中仇恨，纵然宫主要杀我，我也是甘之如饴！”
苏景感觉自己的演技已经完全炸裂了，他眼神悲痛，面容绝望，道：“所以我恳请宫主，再给我七日的性命！只要我能达成心中所愿，七日后，我必亲至移花宫，要杀要剐悉听尊便！”
邀月的眼睛眯了起来，慢慢道：“你当真是如此想的？”
“那是自然！”
苏景心知恐怕邀月还未完全相信自己是要害江枫的！真是得亏了自己知道剧情，天可怜见呐……原著里的那个江枫到底是怎么从这个女魔头手底下逃得性命的？
如果换了其他人试炼的话，又会怎么做才能有一线生机呢？
不过我的话，是只有这个方法了……
如果不让邀月给自己下一个保险，恐怕她是绝不会放任自己离开的了！

想着，苏景说道：“不错，我知晓移花宫中绝世武学多不胜数，宫主定可在我身上种下禁制，就不怕我撒谎了！”
邀月似笑非笑道：“当真？哪怕我在你体内留下一道气劲？让你直接七日后七窍流血死于非命？！”
“不错！！！”
苏景回答的斩钉截铁，反正七天后老子就从哪里来回哪里去了……虽然是初入轮回，但这一切的一切，都和无限流太像太像，苏景几乎有百分百的把握，只要自己完成任务，七天后自己绝不会死！
而且主神也说了，它能治疗任何伤势！
“好，那我便在你体内留下一道暗劲……”
邀月冷笑道：“只是江琴你务必小心，如果你是骗我，明玉神功天下无双，纵然燕南天也救不得你！”
“我本就不需燕南天来救！”
苏景苦笑道：“我活的甚是无趣，若不能得偿我心中所愿，情愿一死了之！”
“好！那我便动手……”
“且慢！！！”
邀月眼神一凛，“怎么？你反悔了？莫非你是在骗我？”
苏景羞涩的笑了笑，说道：“自然不是，只是江枫那厮一心想和花月奴长相厮守，他们两人夫妻琴瑟和鸣，却也少不得那油盐酱醋茶，江枫竟然散尽了自己的万贯家产，尽数换成了珍贵的明珠！而这些都经过了我的手……可我没想到那么多的财宝，却惊动了在江湖上恶名昭彰的十二星相！”

content_en:
Su Jingdao: "I went to Yan Nantian not to save his life, but to tell Yan Nantian that Jiang Feng was held hostage by the enchantress from Yihua Palace. The enchantress took a fancy to his beauty and pushed him to death, which prevented him from being free..."
Having said this, Yao Yue frowned, with an unhappy look on her face!
When you scold a bald man in front of a monk... you are even scolding yourself!
If the world of reincarnation had an achievement system, I'm afraid Su Jing would have already achieved the achievement of being the first person to scold Yaoyue!
But looking at Su Jing's angry look, Yao Yue could only think that he was angry and spoke indiscriminately.
At this time, facing a demon like Yao Yue, Su Jing did not dare to slack off at all. He taunted a little, and his brain was thinking quickly. He even said it quickly before he could even organize the follow-up plan. At this time, the test was quick wit, and there must be no flaws. If she could see that she was thinking, she would really be doomed!
He explained: "Palace Master Yao Yue may not know something. Although Yan Nantian, the best swordsman in the world, has high martial arts, his character is extremely rough and reckless. I worked as a bookboy under Jiang Feng and had many contacts with him. He trusted me very much and was willing to bring Yan Nantian to Jiang Feng. If I tell Yan Nantian, Huayue Nu will be the one who holds Jiang Feng hostage..."
Yao Yue's body trembled, and she looked at Su Jing with a faint flash of light in her eyes, saying, "Yan Nantian will definitely not come forward to challenge him if he throws a rat weapon. If you encourage him from the side, it will not be difficult for him to sneak attack from behind!"
Su Jing sneered and said, "I just want to see what Jiang Feng's expression looked like when his closest relatives killed his loved ones, and the reason for the action was to save him... interesting..."
"It's not just you who wants to see it...even I can't help but want to see it..."
The expression on Yao Yue's face was ferocious and scary... but she couldn't hide the joy in her eyes. She looked at Chu Nan with deep admiration...
She said: "In this case, it's really lucky that I didn't kill you directly. Otherwise, wouldn't we be able to see such a good show?"
"It doesn't matter if I die or not... The Huayue slave on my left has already given birth to a pair of children for Jiang Feng. I can't possibly want this shabby shoe again. I have no interest in this life... As long as I can see Jiang Feng and her painful face, as long as it can repay the hatred in my heart, even if the palace wants to kill me, I will be happy!"
Su Jing felt that his acting skills had completely exploded. His eyes were sad and his face was desperate, and he said: "So I beg the palace master to give me another seven days of life! As long as I can achieve what I want in my heart, after seven days, I will personally go to Yihua Palace to kill or behead you!"
Yaoyue's eyes narrowed and she said slowly, "Do you really think so?"
"That's natural!"
Su Jing knew that Yao Yue might not fully believe that she wanted to harm Jiang Feng! It's a shame that I know the plot, how wretched it is... How did Jiang Feng in the original work escape from this female devil?
If it were someone else who tried it, what would they do to have a chance of survival?
But as far as I'm concerned, this is the only way...
If Yao Yue didn't let her take insurance, I'm afraid she would never let her leave!
Thinking about it, Su Jing said: "Yes, I know that there are countless peerless martial arts in Yihua Palace. The master of the palace can definitely plant a ban on me, so he won't be afraid of me lying!"
Yaoyue said with a half-smile but not a smile: "Seriously? Even if I leave a trace of energy in your body? Let you bleed to death from your seven orifices seven days later?!"
“Not bad!!!”
Su Jing's answer was categorical. Anyway, I will be back and forth from where I came in seven days... Although it is the first time to enter reincarnation, everything is so similar to Infinite Flow. Su Jing is almost 100% sure that as long as he completes the task, he will never die in seven days!And the Lord God also said that it can heal any injury!
"Okay, then I will leave a dark energy in your body..."
Yaoyue sneered and said, "Jiang Qin, you must be careful. If you are lying to me, Mingyu's magical skills are unparalleled in the world, and even Yan Nantian can't save you!"
"I don't need Yan Nantian to save me!"
Su Jing smiled bitterly and said: "My life is very boring. If I can't get what I want, I would rather die!"
"Okay! Then I'll take action..."
"Wait!!!"
Yaoyue's eyes turned sharp, "What? You regretted it? Are you lying to me?"
Su Jing smiled shyly and said: "Of course not, it's just that Jiang Feng only wanted to stay with Hua Yuenu forever. The two of them played the piano and played the piano in harmony, but they couldn't live without the oil, salt, sauce and vinegar tea. Jiang Feng actually dissipated all his wealth and exchanged it for precious pearls! And these all passed through my hands... But I didn't expect that so much treasure would disturb the notorious twelve stars in the world!"
